a.lede: Private KyTyPS5 fork shows Demon's Souls running at 40-50 FPS with accurate graphics — new milestone only three weeks after the game barely booted
a.title: Demon's Souls reaches 40-50 FPS on private PS5 emulator with accurate graphics

b.lede: SharpEmu’s latest release can run six tested PS5 games at 60 FPS, with 12 of 55 titles now reaching gameplay state, as developers improve shader translation and Vulkan support.
b.title: PS5 emulator successfully runs six titles at a playable 60 FPS
